title: Young Bolden, Manuel Hall and playing by ear
summary: When Jones arrived Bolden was just learning, with no band; Manuel Hall broke him in. Bolden could hear a band at the theater and play the piece at the dance that night.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear
